title: Understanding the Code Structure
text: The code is using the `groupby` function to group the data by a specific column. This is followed by an aggregation function to find the mode of $$`hour_{of,visit}`$$ for each activity category. Think about which column is used to categorize the activities.

title: Identifying Missing Values
text: Which function is used to identify missing values in a DataFrame?

title: Using the Mode for Imputation
text: The mode is the most frequently occurring value in a dataset. In this context, it is used to fill in missing $$`hour_{of,visit}`$$ values based on the activity type. Consider how the mode is calculated for each group.
